title: Integrated slice-mass bound from the pointwise bound (Simon Ch. 6, 4.10)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, f : ℝ^P → ℝ measurable, W ⊆ ℝ^P measurable, L ≥ 0, m : ℝ → [0, ∞] an arbitrary function and a, b ∈ ℝ. Suppose m(t) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for every t ∈ (a, b). Then the lower Lebesgue integral satisfies ∫⁻_{(a,b)} m(t) dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (a b : ℝ), Measurable f → MeasurableSet W → (∀ t ∈ Ioo a b, m t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, m t ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b})
